subject: Information Theory
title: Polar Codes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Polar Codes.

hook.text: In 2009, Erdal Arıkan proved something remarkable: polar codes provably achieve channel capacity with simple encoding.

buildup.text: Polar codes exploit channel polarization: as block size grows, synthetic subchannels become either perfect or useless.

discovery.text: Send data on the perfect subchannels, freeze the useless ones. The code naturally adapts to the channel.

twist.text: Polar codes are the first codes proven to achieve Shannon capacity with efficient encoding and decoding.

climax.text: 5G uses polar codes for control channels. Huawei championed them; Qualcomm backed LDPC. Both won different roles.

punchline.text: Channels polarize. Use the good ones. Ignore the bad.

quiz.question: What unique property do polar codes have?
options: They provably achieve channel capacity with efficient decoding
